key_insight: Random encoders plus expurgation produced 192 explicit qubit stabilizer codes whose exact distances improve known lower bounds, raising 1,873 Grassl table entries through propagation.
engineering_relevance: The constructions offer better logical-qubit capacity at fixed code length and distance, but practical value still depends on decoding and implementation costs.
method: Generate random Clifford encoders and enumerate logical operators below the target distance.
Promote selected logical operators to stabilizers to eliminate low-weight logical errors; construct two codes by puncturing and repair.
Certify distances using exhaustive meet-in-the-middle enumeration and explicit weight-d logical operators.
evidence_signal: All 192 codes have exact certified distances, with lengths 53–254 and distances 5–13; 161 improve prior lower bounds by one and 31 by two, with public codes, certificates and an independent checker.
watch_item: Certification enumerated up to 4×10^13 Pauli operators, indicating substantial scaling costs; the 619 further predicted improvements remain unverified.
paper_title: Random encoders and expurgation improve 1,873 entries of the Grassl qubit code tables
